# go-adk-q

> Google ADK Go reference implementation: every agent pattern + multi-provider
> LLM failover + Bubbletea TUI. Zero-config AI onboarding built in.

## AI Memory (load first)

- /docs/ai-memory/QUICK_CONTEXT.md — ~300-token project summary for one-off prompts
- /docs/ai-memory/SYSTEM_PROMPT.md — ~2000-token system prompt for full chat sessions
- /docs/ai-memory/README.md — Tool-by-tool AI onboarding guide (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Aider, ChatGPT)
- /AGENTS.md — Canonical AI coding instructions (all rules, skeletons, conventions)
- /llms-full.txt — Full RAG context ~15 000 tokens (index this into your vector store)

## Tutorials

- /docs/tutorials/get-started.md — Run the TUI in 5 minutes
- /docs/tutorials/first-agent.md — Build and run a custom FunctionTool agent
- /docs/tutorials/add-provider.md — Add a new LLM provider end-to-end

## How-To Guides

- /docs/how-to/add-agent.md — Add a new agent to main.go
- /docs/how-to/add-skill.md — Add a SKILL.md to the agent skill library
- /docs/how-to/add-provider.md — Provider checklist (quick reference)
- /docs/how-to/add-theme.md — Add a Bubbletea TUI colour theme
- /docs/how-to/debug-tui.md — Debug TUI rendering bugs

- /docs/reference/config.md — All environment variables
- /docs/reference/cli.md — CLI flags, keyboard shortcuts, slash commands

- /docs/reference/themes.md — Theme index and palette fields

- /docs/explanation/pitfalls.md — 10 documented gotchas: symptom → root cause → fix

## Architecture Decision Records

- /docs/adr/ADR-0001-adk-as-agent-layer.md — Why ADK (not Genkit flows or custom framework)
- /docs/adr/ADR-0002-genkit-compat-oai.md — Genkit used only for oaibridge
- /docs/adr/ADR-0003-failover-buffered.md — Buffered failover rationale
- /docs/adr/ADR-0004-lipgloss-join-vertical.md — Why JoinVertical was removed
- /docs/adr/ADR-0005-provider-config-pattern.md — Config struct + ConfigFromEnv pattern
- /docs/adr/ADR-0006-skills-toolset.md — Why skills use SKILL.md + SkillToolset
- /docs/adr/ADR-0007-skilltoolset-schema-patch.md — Why list_skills/load_skill schemas are patched

## Companion / Related Projects

- /dino-mcp/ — Go MCP server reference: 3 tools + interactive HTML dashboard (Gin + ext-apps SDK)
  Documentation indexed in context-mode as `dino-mcp-docs`

## Source (key files)

- /main.go — All agent definitions and ADK launcher
- /cmd/tui/main.go — TUI entry point, Cobra subcommands, provider registration
- /cmd/tui/chat.go — Bubbletea model, themes, rendering
- /tools/tools.go — FunctionTools: get_weather, get_current_time
- /tool/skilltoolset/skilltoolset.go — Schema-patched SkillToolset for OpenAI-compat
- /model/failover/failover.go — Multi-provider failover chain (buffered)
- /model/oaibridge/bridge.go — Genkit compat_oai bridge (only Genkit import)
- /model/catalog/catalog.go — ModelEntry registry for /model picker
- /agents/llmauditor.go — Custom Run func agent pattern
- /agents/collaboration/ — Multi-agent via agenttool patterns
